B Bakehouse NY Baked from scratch since 2016 2026

Bakehouse NY bakes for restaurants, cafés, hotels and caterers across New York, alongside its own neighbourhood café. Most of the business, 75% or more, is wholesale.

Plenty of wholesale suppliers sound cold and transactional. Bakehouse NY is the warm one: the same bakery, the same founders and the same products made from scratch, whoever it is talking to. One line carries it everywhere: baked from scratch since 2016.

A BH monogram set inside a seal with a double ring, paired with the BAKEHOUSE wordmark. The seal works on its own as a stamp, sticker or profile picture, and the type pairs Caslon Ionic with Satoshi on blue, cream and black.

A master baker's voice: confident, warm and expert without pretension. No hype, never snobbish, never corporate. The book shows it line by line, so 'Croissants made from scratch, baked fresh daily' goes out and 'next level croissants you'll crave' never does.
